clauses.text: Every full-time employee gets 24 days of annual leave per calendar year, credited at the start of the year.
Employees get 12 days of sick leave per year. Sick leave of more than 2 consecutive days needs a medical certificate.
Employees get 6 days of casual leave per year for short personal needs. Casual leave cannot be combined with annual leave.
Leave requests must be submitted in the HR portal at least 5 working days before the start date for planned leave, and approved by the reporting manager.
New joiners can take annual leave after completing 3 months of service. Leave is prorated in the joining year.
Up to 10 days of unused annual leave can be carried forward to the next calendar year. Leave carried forward must be used by 31 March of the next year.
Unused annual leave above the carry-forward limit lapses at the end of the calendar year and is not paid out, except on exit.
On exit, unused annual leave up to 30 days is encashed at the employee's basic daily rate as part of the full and final settlement.
All full-time employees are covered by group health insurance of 5 lakh rupees per year, including spouse and up to two children.
Cashless hospitalisation is available at network hospitals. Employees must show the insurance card and a company ID at admission.
Parents can be added to the health insurance policy at an extra premium deducted monthly. Pre-existing conditions are covered after a 2-year waiting period.
An annual health check-up is provided free of cost at partner diagnostic centres. Dental and vision cover is included up to 10,000 rupees per year.
The company contributes 12 percent of basic pay to the Employees' Provident Fund, matched by an equal employee contribution deducted monthly.
Gratuity is payable after 5 years of continuous service, calculated at 15 days of last-drawn basic pay for each completed year of service.
Employees may make voluntary additional contributions to the provident fund up to 100 percent of basic pay through the HR portal.
Employees travelling outside their base city get a daily allowance of 2,000 rupees for food and local travel, plus hotel costs at actuals up to the city limit.
Domestic air travel is booked in economy class. Flights must be booked at least 7 days in advance unless the travel is urgent and approved by a manager.
Personal car use for business travel is reimbursed at 10 rupees per kilometre. Toll and parking charges are reimbursed at actuals with receipts.
Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the expense date through the expense portal, with original receipts attached for every item above 500 rupees.
Approved expense claims are reimbursed within 10 working days to the employee's registered bank account.
Meal expenses during client meetings are reimbursable up to 1,500 rupees per person. Alcohol is never reimbursable.
Claims without receipts, or submitted after 30 days, are rejected automatically and must be re-submitted with manager approval.
On day 1, new joiners complete HR paperwork: identity proof, address proof, bank details for payroll, and tax declarations. HR verifies the documents the same day.
Every new joiner is assigned a buddy from their team for the first month. The buddy introduces the joiner to the team and answers day-to-day questions.
New joiners must complete compliance training (code of conduct, data privacy, information security) within the first 5 working days.
The first-week schedule is shared by HR before the joining date: day 1 paperwork and orientation, days 2 to 3 team introductions, days 4 to 5 first project work with the manager.
Probation lasts 6 months. A probation review is held at the end of month 3 and month 6 with the reporting manager.
IT sets up the new joiner's laptop, email account, and access to internal tools before the joining date, based on the role and location in the joining form.
New joiners receive their login credentials on day 1 from IT. Passwords must be changed at first login and multi-factor authentication enabled the same day.
Role-specific software and project access are granted by the manager after the joiner completes day 1 orientation. Access requests go through the IT service desk.
Employees may work from home up to 3 days a week with manager approval. The team agrees fixed work-from-home days each month.
Remote employees must be reachable on company chat and email during working hours, and attend all scheduled team meetings by video.
The company provides a one-time home-office setup allowance of 15,000 rupees for a chair, desk, and monitor for employees working remotely more than 2 days a week.
Working from a location outside India needs prior HR approval and is limited to 30 days per year for tax and compliance reasons.
Hybrid employees must come to the office at least 2 days a week. The office days are fixed by the team and published in the team calendar.
Office attendance is recorded by badge swipe at the office entrance. Employees who miss their office days without approval are flagged to their manager.
Meeting rooms are booked through the office portal. Hot desks are available on a first-come basis and must be left clean at the end of the day.
Pay is credited on the last working day of each month to the employee's registered bank account. Payslips are available in the HR portal from the 1st of the following month.
Questions about pay, deductions, or tax on the payslip must be raised with HR payroll, not with the manager. HR responds within 5 working days.
Overtime pay applies only to roles marked as overtime-eligible. Overtime must be pre-approved by the manager and is paid at 1.5 times the hourly rate.
The annual performance bonus is paid in April, based on the appraisal rating and company performance for the previous financial year.
Compensation is reviewed once a year during the appraisal cycle. Pay raises depend on the appraisal rating, market benchmarks, and budget.
Employees may discuss their compensation only with HR. Sharing another employee's pay details is a breach of the code of conduct.
An employee may raise a grievance in writing to HR or through the grievance portal. HR acknowledges every grievance within 2 working days.
Every grievance is reviewed by an HR committee that does not include the person the grievance is about. The employee is heard in person before a decision is made.
Grievances are resolved within 30 days. The employee receives the outcome in writing and may appeal the outcome within 10 days of receiving it.
Any employee who experiences harassment or discrimination may report it to HR or the Internal Committee. Reports are kept confidential and the complainant's identity is protected.
Harassment complaints are investigated by the Internal Committee within 90 days. The complainant and the respondent are both heard, and interim relief can be granted during the inquiry.
Retaliation against anyone who reports harassment or discrimination is treated as a serious misconduct and leads to disciplinary action.
The company sponsors work visas and work permits for employees assigned to client projects abroad. Sponsorship is decided by HR and the project manager together.
Visa applications are filed by the company's immigration partner. Employees must submit a valid passport, photographs, and project documents at least 8 weeks before travel.
Work permit renewals must be started 12 weeks before expiry. HR tracks expiry dates and notifies the employee and manager 3 months in advance.
Employees relocating to another country for work receive immigration support, visa filing, and a relocation allowance as per the relocation policy.
Relocation support includes 15 days of temporary accommodation, shipment of personal belongings up to 200 kg, and a local orientation session.
Dependents of relocating employees receive visa support for spouse and children, including school admission guidance where the company has a local office.

title: Relocation and Visa Support for International Hires

clauses.text: Employees must act with honesty and integrity, respect colleagues regardless of background, and avoid any conflict of interest in their work.
Gifts from clients or vendors above 2,000 rupees must be declared to HR. Cash gifts are never accepted.
Company information, client data, and passwords must be kept confidential. Sharing them outside the company is a breach of the code of conduct.
Misconduct is handled through a disciplinary process: a written notice, a hearing where the employee may respond, and a written decision.
An employee who disagrees with a disciplinary warning may appeal against it in writing to HR within 10 working days of receiving the warning.
Disciplinary outcomes range from a written warning to termination, depending on the seriousness of the misconduct and any previous record.
Every employee is issued a company laptop on joining. Laptop requests for a replacement or an upgrade go through the IT service desk with manager approval.
Company laptops are replaced every 3 years, or earlier if the device is faulty and cannot be repaired. Lost or damaged laptops must be reported to IT within 24 hours.
Employees working remotely may request a second monitor and a headset from IT. Requests are fulfilled within 5 working days of approval.
Employees must use multi-factor authentication on all company accounts and never share passwords. Passwords must be at least 12 characters.
Company devices must have disk encryption and the latest security updates installed. Personal devices used for work must be registered with IT.
Downloading unapproved software or accessing blocked websites on company devices is not allowed and is logged by IT security.
